recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed in core FHIR for FHIR-33319 unless a later work group decision changes the CodeSystem supplement rule itself.
issue_request: FHIR-33319 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CodeSystem technical correction asking for an error invariant so CodeSystem.content = supplement implies CodeSystem.supplements exists, enforcing a supplements rule that previously appeared only in narrative.
initial_application: Git commit 918445a81d8ed5d643fda00b2db872c5901630db added csd-4 to source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml. Commit e522c99cebff40f73a3dc10a5673ee5ed6e5b2b8 then quoted the 'supplement' literal in the FHIRPath expression, and commit 07b4f0122b2fd6f10310442e99e1dd159657935b added invariant-test coverage including a csd-4 failing fixture.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread proposed the invariant and then linked to FHIR-33319. Vocab tracker and WGM minutes confirm the rule as a straightforward technical correction: if a resource says it is a CodeSystem supplement, it must identify the supplemented CodeSystem. source/fhir.ini actively lists CodeSystem, so the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. FHIR-14356 and FHIR-34326 were encountered as broader supplement/status or ShareableCodeSystem/content policy background and do not change this issue's narrow rule.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml contains csd-4 with severity error and expression "CodeSystem.content = 'supplement' implies CodeSystem.supplements.exists()", and CodeSystem.content and CodeSystem.supplements both reference condition csd-4. The narrative supplements section still states the same rule, valid supplement examples include supplements values, and the invariant tests include a supplement instance missing supplements as a failing fixture.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the originating Zulip thread; it concerns Trial Use/status handling for CodeSystem.supplements rather than the csd-4 invariant.
A nearby CodeSystem content/profile issue found in Jira and WGM context; it is separate from requiring supplements when content is supplement.
